mapper.select: select * from ai_conversation where user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0' order by coalesce(last_message_time, create_time) desc, id desc
select * from ai_conversation where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into ai_conversation (user_id, title, mode, project_id, project_name, message_count, generating, create_by, create_time, del_flag) values (#{userId}, #{title}, #{mode}, #{projectId}, #{projectName}, 0, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), '0')
mapper.update: update ai_conversation set title=#{title}, mode=#{mode}, project_id=#{projectId}, project_name=#{projectName}, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate() where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId} and del_flag='0' and generating='0'
update ai_conversation set generating='1', update_time=sysdate() where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId} and del_flag='0' and generating='0'

update ai_conversation set generating='0', message_count=message_count+#{messageIncrement}, last_message_time=sysdate(), title=coalesce(#{title}, title), update_by=#{operator}, update_time=sysdate() where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId} and del_flag='0'
update ai_conversation set del_flag='2', update_by=#{operator}, update_time=sysdate() where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId} and del_flag='0' and generating='0'
update ai_message set del_flag='2', update_by=#{operator}, update_time=sysdate() where conversation_id=#{conversationId} and user_id=#{userId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select * from ai_message where conversation_id=#{conversationId} and user_id=#{userId} and del_flag='0' order by id asc
mapper.update: update ai_message set content=#{content},status=#{status},model=#{model},request_id=#{requestId}, sources_json=#{sourcesJson},tool_calls_json=#{toolCallsJson},token_usage_json=#{tokenUsageJson}, error_message=#{errorMessage},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where id=#{id} and conversation_id=#{conversationId} and user_id=#{userId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select count(i.id) itemCount, count(distinct i.batch_id) batchCount, coalesce(sum(i.total_price),0) totalAmount from cost_boq_item i where i.project_id=#{projectId} and i.del_flag='0'

select t.id latestTaskId, t.task_name taskName, t.status taskStatus, t.issue_count issueCount, coalesce(t.risk_amount,0) riskAmount, (select count(1) from cost_review_issue i where i.review_task_id=t.id and i.del_flag='0' and i.issue_level in ('HIGH','CRITICAL')) highRiskCount from cost_review_task t where t.project_id=#{projectId} and t.del_flag='0' order by t.create_time desc,t.id desc limit 1

select i.id, i.review_task_id reviewTaskId, i.issue_type issueType, i.issue_level issueLevel, i.issue_title issueTitle, i.issue_description issueDescription, i.risk_amount riskAmount, i.status, i.item_code_snapshot itemCode, i.item_name_snapshot itemName from cost_review_issue i where i.project_id=#{projectId} and i.del_flag='0' order by field(i.issue_level,'CRITICAL','HIGH','MEDIUM','LOW','INFO'), i.risk_amount desc, i.id desc limit #{limit}

select i.id, i.batch_id batchId, i.item_code itemCode, i.item_name itemName, i.item_feature itemFeature, i.unit, i.quantity, i.unit_price unitPrice, i.total_price totalPrice from cost_boq_item i where i.project_id=#{projectId} and i.del_flag='0' and (i.item_code like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or i.item_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or i.item_feature like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')) order by i.id desc limit #{limit}
